parameters.note: After a purchase or a restore the phone asks the server this many times whether access is on (K-702): the store's webhook reaches the server seconds to a minute later. With subscription_confirm_interval_ms, about a minute; past it the screen says it can take a minute and offers to look again.
The wait between two of those questions.

The trial reminder (K-707) fires this many days before the trial ends: time to decide and cancel before the first charge. Asked for by the user's tap; a billing notice, not one of the three reminder kinds (ADR-036).

The trial reminder rings at this hour of the phone's own day (K-707 review): never at the hour the trial happened to start — a purchase at 01:30 would ring at 01:30. Mid-morning, when a billing choice can be made.
The yearly plan shows "Save X%" only when it is at least this much cheaper than twelve months of the monthly plan, in the same currency (K-1033, paywall v2): a small saving is not worth a badge.

The header in which the phone lists the features it can show (K-1202). The server reads the same name from data/parameters/quota.yaml (client_features_header); api-client.test.ts holds the two equal. JSON here because the phone cannot read the YAML.
The token the phone sends in client_features_header to say it shows a locked call (K-1202). Equal to quota.yaml locked_calls_feature_token; without it the server never holds a call back.

The upgrade moment of the meal log (ADR-091 #1, K-1202): from this many meals typed by hand in one day, a line suggests logging by photo or text, only while the server says the AI is on. Off in production today, so nothing shows.
